WLD continues to maintain a bullish structure, while the rising trendline is still being respected and price is consolidating above the key support zone.
If WLD manages to hold this support zone, we could see a move toward 0.37 - 0.38 USDT, and over the coming days, if bullish momentum continues, we could potentially see 0.40 USDT.
The key level to watch is the current support zone. A clean hold would keep the bullish structure intact, while losing this area could lead to a short-term correction.
